description: Team Relica is five teammates from Madinah, Saudi Arabia, with backgrounds in Information Technology, Data Science and Mechanical Engineering. We built RELICA: Still Here, a browser 3D story game where players become the machines NASA left on the Moon and Mars, carry out their real missions, then see the original NASA photos. Our skills: storytelling, creative direction, game engine and physics, world and character design, UX and sound. Play it: https://relica-pi.vercel.app
